PCSTATS.AccessRoleHint: Users at or above this role see the PC Stats Overlays controls and can open the popout windows.
PCSTATS.ConfigMenuHint: Configure the Banner and Party Row overlays independently.
PCSTATS.TabBannerHint: Horizontal banner — a single rotating card (fields in a row) that shows one character at a time and cycles through sponsor messages. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (TV icon).
PCSTATS.TabVerticalCardHint: Vertical banner — same rotating card as the horizontal banner (one character at a time, sponsor messages, animations) but with fields stacked in a column. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (ID-card icon).
PCSTATS.TabPartyHint: Party row — shows every selected character at once, side by side. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (people icon). Line it up above your scene's character art.
PCSTATS.TabVerticalHint: Party column — shows every selected character stacked in a column. Launch it from the PC Stats Overlays menu (vertical-lines icon). Good for a side rail.
PCSTATS.SelectCharactersHint: Select which characters appear in this overlay.
PCSTATS.NoCharacterActors: No character-type actors found in this world.
PCSTATS.FieldsHint: Drag rows by the handle to set the display order.
PCSTATS.CustomColorHint: Use a custom color for this field
PCSTATS.MessagesHint: Text slides (ads, shoutouts, announcements) mixed into the banner between characters. Banner only.
PCSTATS.MessagePlaceholder: e.g. Tonight's stream sponsored by Acme Dice!
PCSTATS.MessageFrequency: Show a message after every N characters (0 = off)
PCSTATS.CombatHint: Flash a damage/heal animation on a character whose HP changes, then resume. Use the toggle below to limit this to active combat only.
PCSTATS.HighlightActiveTurn: Highlight the character whose turn it is
PCSTATS.SpotlightCurrentTurn: Spotlight current turn (hold on active character)
PCSTATS.CharactersHint: Per-character identity, shared by all overlays: an accent frame color and whether to use token art instead of the actor portrait.
PCSTATS.RotateInterval: Display each card for (seconds, 0 = no rotation)
PCSTATS.ResetConfirm: Reset this overlay's settings to the default parchment theme? This discards its current configuration and cannot be undone.
PCSTATS.NoCharacters: No characters selected. Open the overlay settings to choose some.
PCSTATS.PopupBlocked: The overlay popup was blocked. Allow popups for your Foundry site and try again.
